newsitem.title: USA: Exxon signs Kuwait technical study agreement.
newsitem.headline: Exxon signs Kuwait technical study agreement.

text.p: Exxon Corp said its Exxon Exploration Kuwait Inc unit signed a joint technical study agreement with Kuwait Oil Co.

Exxon said the companies will conduct a joint technical study to evaluate the Kra Al-Maru discovery announced by Kuwait Oil in October, 1995. The Kra Al-Maru area is in west central Kuwait, about 40 miles west of Kuwait City.

The joint study will include an integrated evaluation of the Kra Al-Maru discovery and will initially focus on developing appraisal options for the discovery as well as provide an estimate of hydrocarbon potential, Exxon said.
